reason: I might try it a couple of times, probably the Turkish coffee at 2 JOD or a medium latte when I want to sit with the Wi-Fi and study. But I can't make it my daily coffee on my budget, so my usual cheap grab-and-go stays.
objection: 3 to 3.50 JOD for a latte is too much if I buy every day, and the 5.0 rating is only 37 reviews so I don't know if it's really better than Qahwa BLK.
would_change_my_mind: A student discount or a loyalty card that brings a medium latte down to around 2.25 JOD so I could buy it most days.
